en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj,
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When the man from a group greets (السَّلَامُ), it would suffice (all of) them’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who has said the following from the Imam: “
If one person offers the greeting of peace for a whole group it is considered enough and sufficient.”
